name: DIREN grants to environmental and animal-welfare associations

funder.name: Direction de l'environnement (DIREN), Government of French Polynesia

summary: Territorial call for associations in French Polynesia, with a 90 million XPF envelope in 2026, funding management and restoration of natural areas, invasive-species control and clean-ups, plus animal-welfare work; priority to islands other than Tahiti.
